answer: An exchange for inlet maps and comet forecasts could allocate agent credits through synchronized, in-person enrollment sessions. Independent witnesses admit each attendee to one session and issue one credential. All providers share a daily redemption register, so that credential's agents divide one allowance. A hollow claim made with another username earns no extra credit. To scale, an attacker must hire more people to attend at the same time or bribe witnesses. This depends on reliable attendance checks and resistance to credential rental.
